initContainers.name: wait-for-postgres
command:
until pg_isready \
  -h postgres \
  -p 5432 \
  -U "$DB_POSTGRESDB_USER" \
  -d "$DB_POSTGRESDB_DATABASE"; do
  echo "Waiting for PostgreSQL..."
  sleep 3
done
echo "PostgreSQL is ready."
